faq.q1: Do I need anything complicated to get started?
faq.a1: Nope. Just sign up and you can use it straight away in your browser. If you want the Desktop app, installation is quick too.
faq.q2: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.a2: Yes. You can check appointments and revenue on your phone anytime, even when you're not at the salon.
faq.q3: I'm not tech-savvy. Can I still use it?
faq.a3: Yes. Salora is made for salon owners, not IT people. If you need help getting started, our team will support you.
faq.a4: Yes. Data is stored and backed up regularly. Customer and revenue information is always protected.
faq.q5: Am I locked into a contract?
faq.a5: No. You can upgrade, downgrade or stop anytime. No hidden fees.
faq.a6: Yes. The system automatically splits percentages and sums up pay clearly each month. No more manual calculations.
faq.q7: Is Salora for small or large salons?
faq.a7: Both. You can start small and upgrade as your salon grows.
faq.q8: Can I try before I decide?
faq.a8: Yes. You can try for free before committing.
faq.a9: We reply within 24 hours and support in Vietnamese. You won't be left on your own.

booking.title: Your salon's own online booking page
booking.desc: Every salon gets its own booking link. Customers pick a service and time whenever they like, and you simply approve in the app.
booking.p1Title: A link just for your salon
booking.p1Text: Add it to Facebook, Instagram, Google Maps or send it by message.
booking.p2Text: Service, time, details. No app download or account needed.
booking.p3Title: A favourite stylist or anyone free
booking.p3Text: Customers choose their stylist or let the salon assign whoever is free.
booking.p4Text: New bookings show up in the app instantly. Confirm or decline in one tap.

calendar.title: A clear calendar for every staff member
calendar.desc: The salon's whole day on one screen: who is free, who is fully booked, and which bookings still need someone.
calendar.p1Text: One column per staff member by hour, so you see who is free at a glance.
calendar.p2Text: Bookings grouped by time slot, with unassigned ones highlighted.
calendar.p3Text: A staff member is never booked for two customers at once.
calendar.p4Text: Customers get a reminder before their appointment, so fewer no-shows.

checkout.title: Fast checkout at the front desk
checkout.desc: Pick the service, the staff member and how the customer pays, and the invoice is done. Every payment goes straight into your reports.
checkout.p1Text: Record how each customer paid, so the till matches at closing.
checkout.p2Text: Every payment creates an invoice you can look up later.
checkout.p3Text: Tips are recorded separately and added to staff pay automatically.
checkout.p4Text: Revenue updates in your reports right away.

customers.title: Customers & loyalty
customers.desc: Every customer has a profile: visits, last visit, upcoming bookings and total spend. Regulars are recognised instantly.
customers.p1Text: Service history and spending in one place.
customers.p2Text: Search by name, phone or email.
customers.p3Text: Set the rules once and VIP customers are recognised automatically.
customers.p4Text: Keep regulars coming back with a points programme.

services.title: Services & price list
services.desc: All your services in one table: category, duration and price. You choose which ones appear on your online booking page.
services.p1Text: Nails, lashes, hair... each group has its own colour.
services.p2Text: Appointments take the right length from the service.
services.p4Text: Filter, search and change many services at once.

reports.title: Overview, revenue & invoices
reports.desc: Open the app and see how the salon is doing today. Reports by month, staff member and service, ready for your accountant.
reports.p1Text: Today's revenue, bookings, customers and top staff.
reports.p2Text: See who performs best and which services sell.
reports.p3Text: Totals by cash, card and transfer; export to PDF.
reports.p4Text: The data is ready, no manual collecting.

payroll.title: Automatic payroll
payroll.desc: Each staff member's pay is calculated from their own revenue, by percentage or per service, plus tips. At month end, just review and export.
payroll.p1Text: A percentage of revenue or a set amount per service.
payroll.p2Text: Customer tips go to the right staff member.
payroll.p3Text: Total pay, revenue and number of invoices per staff member.
payroll.p4Text: Transparent for owner and staff alike.

staff.tile: A personal account for each staff member
staff.title: Personal accounts for staff
staff.desc: Each staff member logs in with their own account and sees their own schedule and earnings in real time. The owner decides who sees what.
staff.p1Text: Staff know who they are seeing today and when.
staff.p2Text: Mark a service done as soon as it is finished.
staff.p3Text: Staff check their earnings without asking the owner.
staff.p4Text: Owner, manager, staff: everyone sees exactly their part.
